$comment: Shared keys here are merged into each machine's ~/.pi/agent/settings.json by mise dotfiles (merge = true). To persist a change, edit ~/dotfiles/.pi/agent/settings.json in the dotfiles repo; editing a shared key in the live file is overwritten by the next `mise dotfiles apply`. Machine-local keys Pi writes (deviceId, lastChangelogVersion) stay only in the live file and must not be added here.
